verdict.rationale: ClickUp markets a dedicated 'Triage Agent' that prioritizes bugs, alongside always-on Super Agents, custom agent building and Automations. Incoming bugs can arrive via the Sentry integration, which converts error reports into tasks, so automated AI triage is a named first-party capability. The evidence is only short marketing taglines, though. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the Triage Agent assigns priority, explicit coverage of general tasks beyond bugs, configuration of auto-triggering on new items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
